contentEn:
Vancouver's 2026 commercial renovation market runs $50K to $1.5M per project depending on type and scope. Office refreshes start at $50K; full restaurant builds and medical clinic fit-outs routinely reach $750K to $1.2M. Reno Stars has completed dental clinic, retail and office conversion projects across Burnaby, Richmond and Vancouver — here is what those projects actually cost.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

What Does Commercial Renovation Cost in Vancouver in 2026?

Commercial renovation costs in Metro Vancouver depend on the building type, scope of work and BC Building Code classification. Office refreshes — paint, flooring, lighting, partitions — start at $50K. Full restaurant builds and medical clinic fit-outs routinely reach $750K to $1.2M. The table below reflects Reno Stars' 2025–2026 project data.

Renovation TypeCost per sq ftTypical Total (2026)
Office refresh (paint, flooring, lighting)$80–$160/sq ft$50K–$200K
Retail build-out$100–$300/sq ft$100K–$500K
Restaurant (full kitchen + dining)$200–$500/sq ft$300K–$1.2M
Medical / dental clinic$300–$700/sq ft$400K–$1.5M
Beauty salon / spa$150–$350/sq ft$150K–$500K
Fitness studio / yoga$80–$200/sq ft$80K–$300K

What Vancouver Business Owners Need to Budget For

Beyond the base fit-out cost, four items routinely add $10K to $80K each to a commercial project in Vancouver. Strata buildings (high-rise office) add 10–20% due to work-hour limits, freight elevator bookings and building protection requirements. Heritage buildings add 10–25% on the facade scope due to heritage register restrictions. Pre-1990 buildings may require asbestos abatement ($10K–$80K depending on square footage). HVAC zoning rework for restaurants and medical clinics adds $30K–$80K. Sprinkler system upgrades, triggered by some change-of-use permits, add $25K–$80K.

BC Building Code classification is the single most consequential budget variable. Part 3 buildings (large/complex commercial) require architectural and engineering sealed drawings, BC Building Code references and sprinkler design. Part 9 buildings follow a simpler path. Permit complexity (Part 3 vs Part 9) alone can add $15K–$50K in professional fees. Reno Stars reviews the building classification at every free site walkthrough.

Restaurant Renovation Costs in Vancouver

Restaurant renovation in Vancouver starts at $300K for a basic fast-casual fit-out and reaches $1.2M for a full-service restaurant with commercial kitchen. Beyond the general commercial items above, restaurant projects add five cost categories that do not appear in office or retail work.

Restaurant Item2026 Cost Range
Commercial vent hood (Type I) + roof curb$35K–$90K
Make-up air unit$15K–$35K
Grease trap (1,000 lb interior)$8K–$18K installed
Walk-in cooler (8×10)$25K–$45K
Health-board-compliant prep area + 3-compartment sink$8K–$20K
Liquor licence fit-out$5K–$15K
Patio + outdoor service area$20K–$80K

All restaurant work requires VCH FoodSafe compliance, grease trap installation and a commercial vent hood that meets BC Plumbing Code and NFPA 96 standards. Reno Stars has completed restaurant projects in Richmond and Burnaby; all included health authority sign-off as part of the permit package.

Medical and Dental Clinic Renovation Costs

Medical and dental clinic fit-outs in Vancouver start at $400K for a basic dental office and reach $1.5M for a multi-operator medical clinic. The seven line items below distinguish a clinic build from a standard commercial office.

Clinic Item2026 Cost Range
Lead-lined X-ray room$25K–$60K
Dental chair plumbing + air (per chair)$5K–$10K per chair
HEPA / clinical-grade HVAC$20K–$60K
Sterile prep / autoclave room$15K–$30K
ADA / barrier-free washroom (CSA B651)$25K–$45K
Reception millwork$10K–$25K
BC Building Code Part 3 professional sealed drawings$15K–$50K additional professional fees

See also: Dental Clinic renovation in Burnaby and WFH Office Conversion with Black-Frame Glass Partition in Vancouver for completed Reno Stars commercial and office projects.

Commercial Renovation Timelines in Vancouver

Office refreshes run 4–10 weeks from permit to handover. Retail build-outs take 8–14 weeks. Full restaurant builds run 14–24 weeks including health authority sign-off and grease trap installation. Medical clinic fit-outs run 16–28 weeks, reflecting the additional permit complexity and clinical-grade HVAC commissioning. All timelines assume a BC Building Permit has been obtained; Reno Stars prepares the full permit package as part of every commercial project.

FAQ: Commercial Renovation in Vancouver

Do existing tenants need to vacate during a commercial renovation in Vancouver?

Not necessarily. Three options keep your business open: phased construction (sections close while others stay operational — best for large open retail or offices), off-hours-only work (nights and weekends — used for anchor retail and restaurants where relocation is impractical), or full closure with a written timeline guarantee and daily-rate penalty clause. Reno Stars has coordinated all three approaches for restaurant, retail and office clients in Richmond and Burnaby.

What BC Building Code compliance does Vancouver commercial renovation require?

All Vancouver commercial projects require BC Building Code compliance. Part 3 buildings (large/complex commercial — most retail centres, office towers, restaurants over a certain size) require architectural and engineering sealed drawings, BC Building Code references, sprinkler system design and accessibility to CSA B651 standards. Part 9 buildings follow a simpler path. Reno Stars reviews the applicable BC Building Code classification at the free site walkthrough and includes the correct permit package in every fixed-price quote.

Every Reno Stars commercial project includes a fixed-price quote, BC Building Permit package, $5M CGL insurance, WorkSafeBC coverage and a 2-year workmanship warranty. The process starts with a 60–90 minute free site walkthrough covering existing conditions assessment, lease review, scope discussion and ballpark cost estimate. A written fixed-price quote follows within 14 days.
contentZh:
温哥华2026年商业装修市场，每个项目的费用从$50K到$150万不等，视类型和范围而定。办公室翻新起价$50K；完整的餐厅装修和医疗诊所设备安装通常达到$75K至$120K。Reno Stars已在、本拿比和温哥华完成牙科诊所、零售和办公室转换项目——以下是基于实际项目数据的真实费用。

2026年温哥华商业装修费用是多少？

大温哥华地区商业装修费用取决于建筑类型、工程范围和BC省建筑规范分类。办公室翻新——油漆、地板、照明、隔断——起价$50K。完整餐厅装修和医疗诊所设备安装通常达到$75K至$120K。下表反映了Reno Stars 2025-2026年项目数据。

装修类型每平方英尺费用2026年典型总价
办公室翻新（油漆、地板、照明）$80–$160/sq ft$50K–$200K
零售装修$100–$300/sq ft$100K–$500K
餐厅（完整厨房+用餐区）$200–$500/sq ft$300K–$1.2M
医疗/牙科诊所$300–$700/sq ft$400K–$1.5M
美容院/水疗中心$150–$350/sq ft$150K–$500K
健身工作室/瑜伽$80–$200/sq ft$80K–$300K

温哥华企业主需要预算哪些项目

除基本装修费用外，四项内容通常为大温哥华商业项目各增加$10K至$80K。分层建筑（高层办公室）因工作时间限制、货运电梯预订和建筑保护要求需增加10-20%。历史建筑因遗产登记限制需增加10-25%的立面工程。1990年前的建筑可能需要石棉处理（$10K-$80K，视平方英尺而定）。餐厅和医疗诊所的暖通空调分区改造需增加$30K-$80K。部分用途变更许可触发的消防系统升级需增加$25K-$80K。

BC省建筑规范分类是影响预算最关键的变量。3类建筑（大型/复杂商业建筑）需要建筑和工程密封图纸、BC省建筑规范参考和消防系统设计。9类建筑遵循更简单的路径。许可复杂度（3类与9类）本身即可增加$15K-$50K的专业费用。Reno Stars在每次免费现场踏勘时都会审查建筑分类。

温哥华餐厅装修费用

温哥华餐厅装修基本快餐店装修起价$300K，完整服务餐厅可达$120K。除了上述一般商业项目外，餐厅项目还需增加五个在办公室或零售装修中不存在的成本类别。

餐厅项目2026年费用范围
商业排油烟罩（I型）+屋顶基座$35K–$90K
补风机组$15K–$35K
油脂拦截器（1000磅室内型）$8K–$18K安装
步入式冷藏室（8×10）$25K–$45K
符合卫生局要求的备餐区+三槽洗涤池$8K–$20K
酒牌装修$5K–$15K
露台+户外服务区$20K–$80K

所有餐厅工程均需符合VCH FoodSafe标准、油脂拦截器安装和符合BC省管道规范和NFPA 96标准的商业排油烟罩。Reno Stars已在列治文和本拿比完成餐厅项目；所有项目均包含作为许可包一部分的卫生局最终审批。

医疗和牙科诊所装修费用

温哥华医疗和牙科诊所设备安装基本牙科诊所起价$400K，多操作员医疗诊所可达$150K。以下七项是诊所装修区别于标准商业办公室的额外费用项目。

诊所项目2026年费用范围
铅衬X光室$25K–$60K
牙科治疗台管道+空气（每台）$5K–$10K/台
HEPA/医疗级暖通空调$20K–$60K
无菌准备/高压灭菌室$15K–$30K
ADA/无障碍卫生间（CSA B651）$25K–$45K
接待区木制品$10K–$25K
BC省建筑规范第3部分专业密封图纸额外专业费用$15K–$50K

温哥华商业装修工期

办公室翻新从许可到交付需要4-10周。零售装修需要8-14周。完整餐厅装修包括卫生局审批和油脂拦截器安装需要14-24周。医疗诊所设备安装需要16-28周，反映了额外的许可复杂性和医疗级暖通空调调试。所有工期均以已获得BC省建筑许可为前提；Reno Stars在每个商业项目中准备完整许可包。

常见问题：温哥华商业装修

温哥华商业装修期间现有租户需要腾空吗？

不一定。三种选择可保持营业：分段施工（部分区域关闭，其他区域继续运营——最适合大型开放式零售或办公室）、仅非工作时间施工（夜间和周末——用于无法搬迁的主零售和餐厅）或全封闭并提供书面工期保证和日费率罚款条款。Reno Stars已为列治文和本拿比的餐厅、零售和办公室客户协调过以上三种方式。

温哥华商业装修需要哪些BC省建筑规范合规？

所有温哥华商业项目均需符合BC省建筑规范。3类建筑（大型/复杂商业建筑——大多数购物中心、办公楼、一定规模以上的餐厅）需要建筑和工程密封图纸、BC省建筑规范参考、消防系统设计和CSA B651无障碍标准。9类建筑遵循更简单的路径。Reno Stars在免费现场踏勘时审查适用的BC省建筑规范分类，并在每份固定价格报价中包含正确的许可包。
